notes.title: Update v1.21.0
notes.notes:
🔥🔥🔥 Season 3 is Live! 🔥🔥🔥


New threats creep from the dark! Face off in 3 brand-new Raids, uncover powerful Consumables and discover new Artifacts, Runes and the Demon Hunter Set. An improved Battle Report, several balance tweaks, QoL upgrades and a full cart of bug fixes round out this update.
⚔️ Ready your clan - and if you enjoy the game, consider leaving a review⚔️

Full Patch Notes:

*New Features*
- Added 3 new Raids:
-- Black Widow: Unlocks after clearing 'Forest Troll' Raid
-- Shadow Twins: Unlocks after clearing 'Black Widow' Raid
-- Venomous Trinity: Unlocks after clearing 'Shadow Twins' Raid

- Added new type of Items: Consumables
-- Clear Forest Trolls -> unlock 'Potion of Traits'
-- Clear Venomous Trinity -> unlock 'Potion of Rebirth'
-- Clear Storm Wyvern -> unlock 'Potion of Growth'
-- Very low chance to encounter them in the Shop at any time
-- Chance to encounter Potions is much higher during Artifact selection events (~3%)

- Added 4 new Artifacts:
-- Blueberries - Forest, Battle 40+
-- Spider Idol (Lower Half) - Raid 'Black Widow' reward
-- Spider Idol (Upper Half) - Raid 'Shadow Twins' reward
-- Black Lotus Ring - Raid 'Venomous Trinity' reward

- Added 3 new Runes:
-- Cleanse: On Ultimate, Profession, T2 - T3
-- Treasure Hunter: Support, Clear-Cut, All Tiers
-- Challenger: Support, Clear-Cut, All Tiers

- Added 2 new Items:
-- Demon Hunter Shoulders (Thief Shoulders, craftable)
-- Demon Hunter Blindfold (Thief Helmet, craftable)

- Added 1 new Item Set: Demon Hunter Set


*Changes and QoL*
- Changes to Raids:
-- Dragon Raids will now unlock after clearing all Spider Raids
-- Dragon Raids levels have been increased

- Battle Report will now show more details when hovering over the respective bars

- When using a 2H weapon, the dwarf details will now show all item slots as occupied

- Increased idle gem reward on the Title Screen

- In Eternal Mode, Orcs beyond the 100 sign will gain increased weight based on distance

- Updated sprite for 'Scarab Brooch' Artifact

- 'Mug of Everlasting Bock' Artifact will now trigger on fatal blow instead of a health threshold

- Increased 'Venom' Rune damage gain against poisoned targets (8% -> 12%)

- Increased 'Plea' Rune Shield buff scaling (120% WIS -> 200% WIS) and fixed an issue with its targeting

- Increased chance for 'Fatality: Shock' Rune from 8% to 10%

- Increased chance for 'Fatality: Freeze' Rune from 8% to 12%

- 'Frostbringer Ring' Artifact will now scale with damage multipliers

- 'Stormbringer Ring' Artifact will now scale with damage multipliers and deal damage regardless of mana burned


*Bug Fixes*
- Fixed an issue where several AoE effects were unable to hit bosses

- Fixed a bug where DoTs would tick an additional time when being re-applied while still active

- Fixed an issue where the Hard Training achievement would be granted incorrectly

- Fixed an issue where boars could spawn slightly above ground

- Fixed an issue where 'Kugelblitz' Ultimate always had double crit chance

- Fixed an issue where 'Chakram Throw' Ultimate would not work against Dragons

- Fixed some issues with Raid DPS Bars for Dragons

- Fixed an issue when displaying the Raid abilities 'Trollblood', 'Spiderblood' and 'Dragonblood'

- Fixed an issue where the 'Execute' Ultimate would not work correctly

- Fixed a bug where the Debuff duration Mythic Forge Modifier did not work correctly

- Fixed an issue when trying to display the Troll Ultimate details

- Fixed an issue where the 'Execute' Ultimate description was missing

- Fixed an issue where Thorn damage was not applied on melee defense

- Fixed an issue where all Orcs would equip 'Scarab Brooch'

- Fixed an issue where the Passive of 'Eagle Talon' and 'Tailpipe Shoulders' would change when downgrading

- Fixed an issue where Fatality Runes would not trigger correctly from DoTs

notes.notes:
Update v1.20.0 - Achievement Hunters - is here!


Full Patch Notes:

*New Features*
Added 25 new Steam Achievements

Adjusted old Steam Achievements to grant more gems and have less requirements

Added 'Free Black Market' (unlocks after 150 victories)

Updated several ability descriptions and added tags to all abilities in the Dwarf details

Added 1 new Artifact: Gauntlet of Swiftness (Cave, Battle 30+)

Added Rune Circle Loadouts after completing the Rune Circle (obtain 12510 Rune Points)

Added 'Data Settings' to the Settings Menu:

Restore default settings

Reset all game data

Try to restore old game data files

Added 6 new Formations:

Holy Alliance

Dark Pact

Riders on the Storm

Squires of Fires

Icebreakers

Bludgeon Company

Added 3 new craftable Items:

Serpent Staff

Hat of the Serpent

Gown of the Serpent

Added 1 new Item Set: Serpent Set

Added Chieftain items to obtainable item preview and slightly adjusted victory requirements

Added visual effects for all basic melee attacks

Added new type of Quest: Disassembling

Added 'Fractured' debuff

Added more info to Status Effects in the Dwarf Details

Added 'Range' stat to Dwarf Details

Added debuff indicators to all characters on the battlefield

Added more info to Dwarf Portrait Battlefield tooltips

Added setting to always show Item and Dwarf details in tooltip

Added setting to mute Menu Button sound effects

Added new basic attack for Fists: Punch


*Changes and QoL*
*General*

Right clicking on an equipped Artifact will now send it directly to the inventory

The game will now save the current clan status when confirming to close the game window

Adjustments to mage basic attacks (Weapons have been changed accordingly):

Frost: Slow AoE attack with lower scaling

Fireball: Balanced single target attack with high burn chance

Thunder: fast attack speed, low minAtk - high maxAtk, cannot be dodged

Resistance scaling has been reduced for everyone:

Old: % resistance = (1 - (100/(100 + resistanceValue)) * 100

New: % resistance = (1 - (200/(200 + resistanceValue)) * 100

Reroll costs will now scale more smoothly up to victory 100 and will start to increase afterwards:

Victory 100: 190 -> 216

Victory 200: 390 -> 625

Victory 300: 590 -> 1211

Victory 500: 990 -> 2649

Victory 1000: 1990 -> 7168

Damage type will now always follow the Pattern: Veteran Passive > Shoulders > Offhand > Mainhand

Increased damage of Crusader Hammer from 8% to 10% of weight

Burn damage tick rate will now always be affected by the lowest tick rate for the full duration (instead of last attacker)

Changes to 'Burn' debuff:

Stacks now count as regular stacks and removing a debuff will generally only remove 1 stack

'Healing Rain' Ultimate will remove all Burn stacks at once

Damage and defensive multipliers have been adjusted:

All damage multipliers of the same category (e.g. damage from status effects: damage vs poison and damage vs fear) are now additive instead of multiplicative

Total damage formula: sum of flat/permanent damage increases (e.g. from Runes) * sum of temporary battle damage boosts (e.g. Orb of Mana, Attack Up buff) * sum of on hit damage boosts (e.g. depending on target status)

Total defense formula: all effects are multiplicative as long as they are unique

'Eternal' clan setting option now has an unlocking condition

Formation 'Wizardry' now scales with 5% per Wizard

Formation 'Rangers' now scales with 5% per Ranger

*Items and Abilities*

Updated several sprites

'Archangel Figurine' will now display its activations during battle but no longer has a growth effect

'Razorblade Ring' now additionally has a chance to apply the 'Fractured' debuff

'Phoenix Feather' is now limited to 3 total uses

'Pinned' Debuff additional effect: Reduce dodge chance by 30%

'Frozen' Debuff additional effect: Receive 25% less damage, but unable to block, dodge or parry

Reworked 'Amulet of Warding'

Adjusted stats for 'Cane of the Ancient'

The following artifacts are now available after 20 victories (instead of 25): Amulet of Warding, Ring of Blood, Razorblade Ring

The poison debuff of 'Toxic Flask' and 'Gas Grenade' can no longer be resisted/blocked/dodged

'Bloodseeker' now has an additional effect: cannot be blocked or dodged

Artifact 'Kakapo Egg' will now only grant +1 STA after battle (down from +2 STA)

Passive 'Frost Blade' now adds magic penetration instead of armor penetration

'Orb of Mana' (level 100 -> 110) and 'Pickaxe' (level 110 -> 100) have swapped unlock positions

Ultimate 'Pyromaniac' is no longer blockable

'Storm Cowl', 'Storm Shoulders' and 'Moonlight Hood' have been moved one tier up in the shop

'Serpent Staff' has been removed from the normal shop, but sprite and stats have been updated for crafting

Slightly decreased number of target scaling for 'Thunderstorm', 'Phoenix' and 'Piercing Arrow'

'Thunder', 'Thunderstorm' and 'Kugelblitz' will now deal damage based on 0.5 * INT - 2 * INT damage

Updated 'Tornado' description and slightly lowered its damage scaling

Reduced life regen mythic forge modifier from 5% to 4%

'Djinn Set' chance to remove a debuff increased from 15% to 20% 

'Doom' damage now increases with the damage modifier, but only deals 0.5*(INT+STR+DEX) dmg per debuff (down from 1.0)

'Battlerune: Cataclysm' additional damage now scales with the amount of debuffs on the enemy, similar to Doom

Changed 'Dragon Set' bonus to: Regenerates an additional 10 mana per second and buffs last 25% longer.

Changed 'Divine Set' bonus to: Stossgebet now also restores 30% of the target's max Mana.

*Professions*

Changes to Beastmaster:

Off-hand will now have a random Passive (same as Knight/Thief off-hands)

Off-hand can now be reforged to change the Passive by combining it with two Knight/Thief off-hands

Changes to Cannoneer:

Attack Speed will now start at 100% (up from 50%) and increase to 200% over 10 seconds (unchanged)

Increased Speed on gear

Reduced base attack speed for 'Cannon (2H)' from 1.5 to 1.0

Increased required mana for 'Gas Grenade' Ultimate from 100 to 200

Added 8 Passives for 'Tailpipe Shoulders':

Corrosive Shells: Physical Element. 20% chance to apply Poison. Reloads at 110% of attack speed.

Disruptor Shells: Dark Element. 20% chance to apply Silence. Reloads at 90% of attack speed.

Explosive Shells: Physical Element. 20% chance to explode. Reloads at 60% of attack speed.

Galvanic Shells: Thunder Element. 20% chance to apply Shocked. Reloads at 150% of attack speed.

Incendiary Shells: Fire Element. 20% chance to apply Burning. Reloads at 125% of attack speed.

Shattering Shells: Holy Element. 20% chance to apply Fractured. Reloads at 80% of attack speed.

Shrapnel Shells: Physical Element. 20% chance to apply Bleeding. Reloads at 130% of attack speed.

Subzero Shells: Ice Element. 20% chance to apply Frozen. Reloads at 100% of attack speed.

Changes to Reaper:

'Harvest' Ultimate now executes targets below 10% max health

'Harvest' Ultimate bonus damage vs low health targets increased from 0.25% to 1% per 1% of missing health

'Crimson Set' Reaper bonus now additionally grants 'Harvest' a 50% chance to Silence for 5 seconds

Fixed a bug where 'Harvest' would sometimes deal way too much damage when striking multiple targets

*Runes*

Updated visuals for inactive Advanced Profession Runes in the Rune Circle

Rune 'Horror' damage increased from 200% to 400% INT when more than 5 stacks of 'Fear'

Rune 'Judgement' and 'Plea' now affect the Holy Element instead of the Priest Profession

*Battle*

Removed automatic Sudden Death from Card Battles:

After 1 minute of battle, you can now order your Dwarves to stop healing and charge forward

Orcs will automatically stop healing and charge forward if they only have healers left \[unchanged]

Bosses will enrage after 3 minutes, increasing their damage by 2% for every second that passes thereafter

Removed mana bar indicators from all characters on the battlefield

Slightly increased base range of Archer, Mage and Priest

Elite Orcs now have the Passive 'Bleeding Blade' and wear the 'Pickaxe' Artifact after battle 100

Reduced knockback factor of 'Thundering Shuriken'

Stamina value of Orcs will start to increase significantly after victory 1000

Priests and Supporters now need to be close to the ally with the lowest HP or the enemy frontline in order to perform their healing

True damage can no longer be absorbed by 'Holy/Dark Crystal' Artifacts or 'Void Slash' Ultimate

Changes to knockback during combat:

Now has some diminishing returns towards the late game

The knockback of attacks and abilities is now always based on their damage scaling stat (STR, DEX or INT)

Changed several abilities to be affected by the correct modifiers

Changes to Speed stat:

Now has some diminishing return for the actual movement speed on the battlefield

This should help managing large speed discrepancies within the clan better

This should lead to an overall less chaotic behavior, especially towards the late game

Decimate (damage beyond the skull sign) is now multiplicative and can no longer be dodged or blocked

All thieves will now jump back less when below 20% health

Limited the max amount of Rimu berries Orcs can throw to 20

*Raids*

Increased gold reward for Dragon Raids

All Wyverns - Dragonscales no longer prevents sharp projectiles, but instead increases physical resistance and reduces damage from projectiles

Flame Wyvern - Ashbringer now removes all buffs before applying burn

Flame Wyvern - Dragon Curse now hits the CLOSEST target with increased knock back effect

Flame Wyvern - Slightly lowered Stamina

Ice Wyvern - Frozen Tomb can no longer be removed via debuff removal

Storm Wyvern - Manaburn has been reworked and renamed to 'Lord of the Storm'

Storm Wyvern - Slightly increased Stamina

All Raid exclusive Artifacts with effects are now unique

Increased Wisdom of Dragons

Forest Troll Raid will no longer drop an additional 'Trolltooth Necklace' Artifact

Raids are now harder (higher level) in Eternal Mode

Changes to boss debuff resistances in Raids:

All bosses now have an additional chance to resist debuffs, additional to some immunities

Debuff resistance will be checked after an attack was successful, i.e. it is easier to inflict debuffs with certain elements

*Miscellaneous*

In the Battle Report, Artifacts will now only be shown if they granted or gained stats

'Thorns' will now always be shown as a passive abilitiy, if the dwarf has any source for thorn damage

Updated descriptions of block/dodge/resistance to list their caps in the Dwarf Details

Updated order of secondary stats and added increased damage stat in Dwarf Details

Increased maximum weight for Tavern Brawl from 10k to 100k

Clarified tooltips for all Battlerunes and Doom

Renamed 'Damage Type' to 'Element'

Updated a few UI sprites

High numbers will now always be displayed shortened

Updated scroll bar sprites

Updated text input fields

Optimized performance when using the 'Phalanx' Formation

Added animation for picking up loot items

Added new in-game hints

Added new section to Guide: Forge

Added info message when an item gets send to Storage

Added damage info to Champion Shoulder Passives

Further optimized several battle effects




*Bug Fixes*
Fixed an issue where bows would state that they scale with Strength (they never did)

Fixed an audio issue with 'Thundering Shuriken'

Fixed a bug where the wrong Artifacts could show up in Quests

Fixed a bug where Highscores for the Challenge leaderboard would not be recorded

Fixed an issue where the Paladin basic ability was not displayed

Fixed a bug where mythic forge modifiers would disappear when transforming between Golden Shield and Golden Aegis

Fixed an issue where Artifacts could be placed in the inheritance storage slot

Fixed an issue where 'Blizzard' and 'Avalanche' would deal less damage than intended

Fixed a bug where DoTs could hit critically

Fixed a bug where knock back of 'Avatar of Fire' and 'Meteor Strike' was based on STR instead of INT

Fixed an audio issue with 'Thundering Shuriken'

Fixed a bug where cancelling the difficulty selection would create a new clan in 'Glory' mode

Fixed a few issues where items could disappear when you did not have enough inventory space

Fixed an issue when displaying the 'Pinned' Debuff in the Dwarf Details

Fixed an issue where 'Poisoned' would always show up as possible Status Effect in the Dwarf Details

Fixed a bug where the Rune Circle Summary would not update after changing Runes

Fixed a few issues with the 'Inheritance' Rune

Fixed an issue where the chance for increased Veteran rerolls was not applied

Potentially fixed a bug where the savefile could become corrupted when exiting the game unexpectedly

notes.title: Update v1.19.0
notes.notes:
Season 2 is here!

Full Patch Notes:

*New Features*
- Season 2 is here!
-- Reset of all leaderboards
-- Introduced additional leaderboards for Eternal: on/off
-- Inheritance Items cannot be brought from the old Season into the new one
- Added Mythic Forge Modifiers (granted once for the first mythic+ upgrade)
-- There are at least 2 unique modifiers per biome
-- Some modifiers can be limited to weapon or item type
-- If you only forge a single main stat onto an item, you can also choose a % modification
-- Available Everywhere: +10% STA, WIS, STR, INT, DEX, SPD, WGT
-- Forest: +5% Armor Penetration, +15% Buff Duration, +5% Bleed Chance (melee weapons)
-- Mountain: +5% Life Regen, +5% Thorns, +5% Block Chance (shields)
-- Cave: +20% Poison Damage, +1 Poison Stack
-- Ruins: +5% Magic Penetration, +10% Faster Burn Damage, +25% Range (ranged weapons)
-- Glacier: -5% Mana Cost, +15% Debuff Duration
- Added 2 new craftable Items:
-- Crescent Blindfold: Assassins Mask + White Reavers Hood + Glacial Crown
-- Crescent Shoulders: Assassins Shoulders + White Reavers Cape + Glacial Pauldrons
- Added 1 new Item Set: Crescent Set
- Added new Formation: Blood Hunters (Requirement: 80% of dwarves have a chance to bleed)
- Added 'Combine All Items' button to Storage to speed up the 3-to-1 item upgrades

*Changes and QoL*
*General*
- Increased Mana Regen gained from WIS and reduced its diminishing return
-- Old formula: WIS * 0.25 * (100/(100 + WIS))
-- New formula: WIS * 0.35 * (300/(300 + WIS))
- All Items will now be shown in the obtainable item list (click on the card jewel)
- All Forge recipes will now be hinted at even before discovering them
- All Formations will now be hinted at even before discovering them
- All Status Effects were added to the 'Battle Effects' section of the Guide
*Items*
- Reworked Artifact 'Scarab Brooch' to boost shielding and healing abilities
- Reworked 'Last Prayer' Ultimate to be able to prevent death blows
- 'Last Stand' Ultimate shield scaling reduced from 50% to 30% max HP
- 'Execute' Ultimate can no longer be prevented by buffs (e.g. Immune, Sacrifice)
- Forks from 'Kugelblitz' will now hit less targets
- Crossbow (2H) now additionally scales with Strength
- 'Iron Storm' Ultimate damage scaling increased to [Weapon Damage + Strength] * 2
- Reduced Speed and Dexterity of 'Explosive Quiver'
- 'Explosive Arrows' will now deal 0.7 * DEX damage (down from 1.0 * DEX)
- Increased stats of 'Quiver of Blight', 'Quiver of the Sun Archer' and 'Moonlight Quiver'
- Changes to 'Sun Archer' Items
-- Quiver: Chance to apply burning increased from 25% to 35%
-- Set: Increased DEX to INT conversion rate from 25% to 50%
- Changes to 'Moonlight' Items
-- Quiver: Chance to apply freezing increased from 15% to 20%
-- Set: Chance to pierce increased from 20% to 35%
- Changes to 'Quiver of Blight'
-- Chance to apply poison increased from 25% to 35%
-- Now additionally increases poison damage inflicted by 35%
- Changes to 'Dark Crystal' Artifact: Increased damage absorption maximum from 40% to 50%
- Changes to 'Holy Crystal' Artifact: Now heals 25% of the wearers max HP
- Beastmaster changes:
-- Can now summon a maximum of 10 boars
-- Set bonus changed to summon an additional boar at the start of battle
- Adjusted prices and stats of several Items
- Increased gold value of all items with increased rarity
- Advanced Items bought from the shop will now always be of normal quality
- Stat modifiers will now always appear in the same order
*Forge*
- Mana Regen and Life Regen modifiers have been removed from the Forge
- Forest biome now has a new modifier: Poison Resistance
- Glacier biome now has a new modifier: Ailment Chance (increases chance to apply already existing debuffs)
- Disassembling items in the Forge will now yield more white Mythril regardless of method
- Mythril will now stay sorted by rarity in the Forge
- Locked items can no longer be placed as ingredients in the Forge if they are mythic+
- Updated layout of the info windows in the Forge
*Runes*
- Variants of Runes will now always be shown when selecting them
- Doubled the chance for all 'Inquisition' Runes
- Changes to 'Judgement' Rune:
-- 'Smite' caused by the 'Judgement' Rune now has a maximum range (10 in terms of sign-posts)
-- Increased chance to activate for T2: 24% -> 56% and T3: 40% -> 80%
- Changes to 'Blacksmith' Rune (increase Mythril obtained when disassembling items):
-- Increased chance for T1: 8% -> 32%, T2: 16% -> 48% and T3: 24% -> 64%
- Increases to item drop chance (e.g. 'Plunder' Rune) will now also affect Champion Item drop chance
*Battle*
- When using 'Hold the Line' Formation with Eternal:off, Dwarves will charge forward after 3 minutes
- Warpriests will now use healing when team health is below 75% (up from 50%) in Eternal mode
- The 'Silenced' debuff will now be displayed in battle and the dwarf details
- 'Orb of Mana' will now also display its activation during battle
- Changes to Dragon bosses in Raid:
-- 'Dragon Storm' now has more range and always deals Thunder damage
-- Storm Wyvern now uses the ability 'Dragon Storm II' which is triggered by any form of physical damage and has more range
- Reduced the visual effect of Artifact activations during combat from 3 to 2 seconds
- Toggling the Auto-Wave-Progress button during battle will now disable the manual upgrade button
- Improved behavior of the Chain Heal and Kugelblitz projectiles
- Optimized several physics calculations
*Miscellaneous*
- Updated several Formations sprites
- Added chance to Chill/Fear as a secondary stat to the Dwarf Details
- 'Poison Arrows' chance for Orcs has been increased from 15% to 25%
- Bone Archer Orcs will now prefer to use 'Poison Arrows'
- Raid loot can no longer be sold in the Battle Report
- Storage page will now stay the same when switching between Halls
- The game will now prevent equipping the same unique Artifacts
- Artifacts dropped in Raids are now locked by default (but can still be unlocked)
- Added current chance and amount of rerolls for Veterans to the Veteran reroll button tooltip
- If you have several Artifact events queued, you can now choose to skip all of them
- Improved wording on several text descriptions
- Added confirmation window when trying to close the game in windowed mode
- Added an animation for the 'Pinned' debuff effect
- After selecting a battle, you can now go 'To War' from almost any hall and set a hotkey

*Bug Fixes*
- Fixed a bug where Explosive Arrows could trigger multiple times when reaching their end of life
- Fixed a bug where 'Explosive Arrows' could trigger multiple times when hitting the ground
- Fixed an issue where opponents could become locked in melee combat without attacking
- Fixed some entries in the Guide
- Fixed a potential bug where Steam Achievements would stop recording when switching Clans
- Fixed an issue where Champion Items could drop multiple times in Eternal mode
- Fixed a bug where some dwarf battle portraits would show up as black squares after death
- Fixed a bug where Artifacts could be rerolled for free
- Fixed a bug where life regeneration would also remove an arrow with each tick
- Fixed a bug where deserted battles could be wrongly transferred to a new clan
- Fixed an issue where the Artifact 'Phoenix Feather' was not appearing correctly in Death (Hard) Mode
- Fixed an issue with Passives sometimes not being displayed correctly in the dwarf details
- Fixed an issue with the interaction of 'Cane of the Ancient' and 'Boots of Speed'
- Fixed a bug where the damage increase stacks of the Artifact 'Tesla Coil' were not applied correctly
- Fixed an issue where mythic Artifacts would still consume resources when trying to upgrade them
- Fixed a few issues when switching between beer and sell cursor in the Tavern
- Fixed an issue where increased damage was not displayed in the Rune Circle summary
- Fixed some issues where certain Status Effects were not displayed in the details (e.g. 'Fear' for 'Umbra Wings')
- Fixed a bug where changes to attack speed during combat were far larger than intended
- Fixed a bug where 'Orb of Mana' was gaining less mana regeneration per stack than intended
- Fixed a bug where the damage reduction buff from 'Sacrifice' would only last 3 instead of 5 seconds
- Fixed a bug where secondary stats were rounded and not displayed correctly in the dwarf details
- Fixed an issue where you could not gain more gold than the integer limit per battle
- Fixed a bug where the Paladin off-hand Justice could also appear in the normal shop
- Fixed a bug where enemies would gain extra EXP from the Rune Circle
- Fixed a bug where the Holy Explosion from the 'Inquisition' Rune was using the wrong damage multipliers
- Probably fixed a bug where the 'Dragon Staff' would suddenly disappear
- Fixed some bugs with the 'Inheritance' Rune
-- You should no longer be able to inherit the same item on multiple Clans
-- You can now inherit a Champion Item (and thus have 2x the same Champion Item)
- Fixed some issues when displaying possible Status Effects in the Dwarf Details
- Fixed a bug where disassembling all items in the Forge would also apply to items placed on the anvil
- Fixed some issues where hotkeys would affect inactive areas of the game
- Fixed a rare issue with the display of the battle report stats
- Optimized projectile behavior and fixed a few smaller issues:
-- Fixed an issue where Axes would not get removed after 10 seconds
-- Fixed an issue where the 'Tornado' projectile could hit the same target too frequently
-- Fixed an issue where piercing cannonballs ('Parabellum' Rune) could be destroyed too early

notes.title: Update v1.18.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dwarf Lords and Battlemasters!

The mountains tremble and the forges roar as we unveil the Rise of Champions, a monumental expansion to your auto-battler RPG experience! This update brings a wealth of new features, enhancements, and surprises to deepen your strategic mastery and celebrate your dwarven legacy.

At the heart of this update are the mighty Champion Dwarves, legendary warriors who can be recruited after achieving 100 victories. These elite fighters come equipped with unique Champion Items, turning the tide of battle in ways never before seen.

But that’s not all! New secrets of the dwarven forges have been unveiled, allowing you to craft brand-new items by discovering rare recipes. Experiment with over 20 new items, artifacts and item sets to create the ultimate loadout for your dwarven armies.

Tacticians will rejoice with the addition of new Formations, offering fresh ways to outmaneuver your foes. Meanwhile, retiring a Dwarf Clan now grants additional gems, rewarding your loyalty and dedication like never before.

We’ve also polished the game with numerous Quality of Life improvements and squashed a host of bugs to ensure your experience is as smooth as a finely honed axe.

notes.title: Update v1.16.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes of the Forge!

We’re excited to unveil our biggest update yet to the Rune Circle System in Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've been hard at work making the Rune System more flexible, user-friendly, and rewarding. Here's what you can expect in this epic overhaul:

Key Changes to the Rune System
✨ Streamlined Mechanics
Gone are the days of complex menus and confusing rules. The Rune System has been reimagined with clarity and simplicity—whether you’re a Rune Master or a novice, you’ll feel right at home.

🛠️ Changes to Existing Runes
Several existing Runes have been adjusted to feel more impactful.

🔥 New Runes to Discover
A batch of brand-new Runes has been introduced, each offering unique abilities to enhance your clan. From inheriting items from an old clan to transforming your Priests into damage dealers, there’s something for every playstyle.

Why We Made These Changes
We heard your feedback: the old Rune System felt restrictive and hard to engage with. This update is all about giving you the freedom to play your way. Build strategies, test your ingenuity, and forge your path to glory!

We can’t wait to see the clever setups and epic victories you'll achieve with these enhancements!

To the mountains, heroes!
- ichbinhamma

Full Patch Notes:

*New Features*
- Chistmas Event:
-- Changed title screen to Winter/Christmas

-- Blacksmith (Support): Increases the base chance to obtain higher grade Mythril from disassembling items

-- Inheritance (Support): Can inherit one item from the Storage for the next clan
-- Judgement (Ultimate): When using an Ultimate, has a chance to cast Smite
-- Chemical Warfare (Ultimate): When using an Ultimate, has a chance to throw a Toxic Flask

-- Harbinger (Offensive): Dark damage increases by 2/4/8% for each stack of Fear on the target, but receive -1/2/4% healing from allies

--- WIS = 10 -> Total Mana Regeneration increased by ~2.27 mana/second
--- WIS = 100 -> Total Mana Regeneration increased by ~12.5 mana/second
- Changed how Dexterity affects Attack Speed:
-- Attack speed now proportionally increases the base Attack Speed of the Weapon
-- The effects of Dexterity on Attack Speed will now diminish with more points allocated
-- Formula: Base Attack Speed * (1 + 3 * (1 -  300/(300 + DEX)))
--- DEX = 1 -> Attack Speed increased by ~1%
--- DEX = 10 -> Attack Speed increased by ~9.6%
--- DEX = 100 -> Attack Speed increased by ~75%

notes.title: Update v1.15.0
notes.notes:
The dwarven realms are abuzz as the crisp winds of autumn arrive, bringing with them exciting new changes and challenges. A highly anticipated feature, the live DPS meter, is now available, allowing you to track your damage output in real time during battles. In addition, Wisdom has elevated its crucial role in enhancing your healing power, making it an even more vital stat for support-focused dwarves. To complement this change, a powerful new Wisdom-scaling artifact has been introduced, giving healers a valuable tool to boost their abilities.

The amount of gems obtained from battles and daily quests has been significantly increased. Veteran dwarves will also notice a rework of their passive abilities, offering fresh strategies and greater flexibility in combat. As the season turns, the first set of leaderboards and challenges for Season 1 is now live, where you can compete and prove your worth among the strongest in the realm.
Alongside these major updates, we've implemented a variety of quality-of-life improvements and balance adjustments to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all adventurers.

Sharpen your axes, fortify your shields, and ready yourselves for glory - there's death to be done, and loot to be won!

your wisdom and leadership have long been pillars of strength within our community.

Change is often met with a mixture of anticipation and apprehension, and we recognize the importance of communication and collaboration during such times.
With the current patch, the Skill Tree has been replaced with the Rune Circle and all invested gems have been refunded. Alongside that, many combat mechanics have been changed and it is very much recommended to retire any clans that still follow the old ways.
We understand that change can be met with skepticism, but we ask for your trust and cooperation as we strive to build a brighter future for our clans.
